reason: When the replacement string is empty, method1 correctly removes all occurrences of the search string and terminates, while method2 fails to advance the search position (gofrom stays at the same index) and therefore loops forever.
nontermination_evidence: In method1, each occurrence of "abc" is replaced by the empty string, shrinking the text until it becomes "" and the loop exits. In method2, lenB is 0, so after each replacement gofrom is set to next + lenB = next, which does not advance. The next search again finds the same index, and the loop never terminates.
